title: Multiple Classes – Lesson Form – Course Field – Non-Editable After Lesson Save
description: AC 01.1 — Negative Testing — Validates that the Course field cannot be changed after a lesson has been saved.
preconditions: - SF org with existing lesson "Lesson MC-01" (Course=Test Course MC)\n- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff
steps_actions:
1. Open the Lesson Detail page for "Lesson MC-01"
2. Click Edit on the Lesson
3. Attempt to locate and change the Course field
4. Cancel the edit
steps_result:
1. Lesson Detail page is displayed
2. Lesson edit form opens
3. Course field is read-only; no dropdown or edit control available
4. Edit closed; original Course value unchanged

title: Multiple Classes – Lesson Form – Class Field – Non-Editable via Lesson Form After Save
description: AC 01.1 — Negative Testing — Validates that the Class field cannot be changed via the standard lesson edit form after save.
preconditions: - SF org flag TRUE\n- Lesson "Lesson MC-01" with Class Alpha and Class Beta via LSC\n- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff
steps_actions:
1. Open Lesson Detail for "Lesson MC-01"
2. Click Edit on the Lesson
3. Attempt to modify the Class field on the edit form
4. Cancel the edit without saving
steps_result:
1. Lesson Detail displayed; Class=Class Alpha, Class Beta
2. Edit form opens
3. Class field is read-only on edit form; cannot be changed
4. Edit closed; Class field still shows "Class Alpha, Class Beta"

title: Multiple Classes – Formula Field – Single-Class Lesson – Single Class Name Displayed (Backward Compatibility)
description: AC 04.2 — Regression Analysis — Validates that the Class formula field on a migrated single-class lesson shows only the single class name with no extra formatting.
preconditions: - SF org post-migration\n- Lesson "Lesson MC-Legacy" has 1 LSC record for Class Alpha\n- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff
steps_actions:
1. Navigate to Lesson Detail for "Lesson MC-Legacy" in SF
2. Locate the "Class" formula field and read its value
3. Navigate to BO Lesson Detail for "Lesson MC-Legacy"
4. Read the Class field value in BO
5. Confirm values match
steps_result:
1. Lesson Detail displayed
2. Class field shows "Class Alpha" only (no trailing comma or extra separator)
3. BO Lesson Detail displayed
4. BO Class field shows "Class Alpha"
5. SF and BO values are identical
